title: An operator-theory construction on geometric lattices
summary: We introduce a canonical operator-theoretic construction associated to a finite geometric lattice, in which a simple nonassociative ``diamond product'' on the lattice basis gives rise to a family of creation operators indexed by atoms and a corresponding self-adjoint Hamiltonian on $\mathbb R[L]$. A key structural feature is that the Hamiltonian changes rank by at most one, so that its compression to the rank-radial subspace is a Jacobi matrix.
